question: Compare TCS and Infosys on cloud strategy

findings.evidence: TCS states that its cloud programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
findings.title: TCS platform overview

findings.evidence: Infosys states that its cloud programme is organised around partner platforms.
findings.title: Infosys platform overview

findings.evidence: Both TCS and Infosys report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
findings.title: Partnership summary

findings.claim: An analyst note compares the two approaches.
findings.evidence: The note contrasts TCS's in-house delivery with Infosys's partner-led model.
findings.title: Analyst note

findings.claim: TCS discloses investment in cloud capability.
findings.evidence: TCS discloses continued investment in cloud training and certification.
findings.title: TCS investment disclosure

findings.claim: Infosys discloses investment in cloud capability.
findings.evidence: Infosys discloses continued investment in cloud delivery centres.
findings.title: Infosys investment disclosure

sections.heading: How TCS and Infosys organise cloud
sections.body: TCS runs cloud through a dedicated unit, while Infosys organises the same work around partner platforms. The two structures lead to different delivery models.

sections.heading: Partnerships and investment
sections.body: Both TCS and Infosys report platform partnerships, and both disclose continued investment in cloud capability, though in different places.

claims.text: TCS delivers cloud work through a dedicated business unit.
Infosys organises cloud work around partner platforms.
Both TCS and Infosys report multi-year platform partnerships.
TCS and Infosys both disclose continued cloud investment.

verdicts.quote: TCS states that its cloud programme is delivered through a dedicated business unit.
Infosys states that its cloud programme is organised around partner platforms.
Both TCS and Infosys report multi-year partnerships with major platform vendors.
TCS discloses continued investment in cloud training and certification.
